citations.quote: Name: Rek'Sai. Official role tags: Fighter, Tank.
While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.

core_mechanics.summary: Burrowed approach threatens a nearby knockup.

purpose: Recognize her engagement pattern and damage focus.
title: Rek'Sai

citations.quote: Rek'Sai's basic attacks and ability hits generate Fury

core_mechanics.summary: Attacks and ability hits generate Fury.

citations.quote: When Rek'sai becomes Burrowed, she rapidly consumes Fury to heal herself while she is wounded.

core_mechanics.summary: Burrowed Fury consumption heals her while wounded.

purpose: Recognize Fury as a source of burrowed recovery.
title: Fury of the Xer'Sai

citations.quote: Rek'Sai empowers her next 3 basic attacks within a few seconds to gain a moderate amount of attack speed and deal bonus physical damage to the target and surrounding enemies.

core_mechanics.summary: Empowered attacks gain attack speed and physical splash damage.

citations.quote: Rek'Sai fires a void bolt in the target direction that detonates on the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies and revealing them for a short time.

core_mechanics.summary: Prey Seeker explodes on collision, dealing magic damage and revealing enemies.

purpose: Recognize the attack enhancement and burrowed projectile as related Q effects.
title: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker

citations.quote: Rek'Sai can also trigger Unburrow by issuing an attack command

advanced_exceptions.summary: An attack command can trigger Unburrow.

citations.quote: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks.

core_mechanics.summary: Burrow changes abilities, increases movement speed, reduces sight, and prevents basic attacks.

citations.quote: Rek'Sai and her allies gain obscured vision of non-visible, moving enemies within range

core_mechanics.summary: Tremor Sense detects unseen moving enemies for Rek'Sai and her allies.

citations.quote: emerging from the ground to deal magic damage to nearby enemies and knock them up
Targets hit cannot be displaced by Unburrow again for some time.

core_mechanics.summary: Emergence damages and knocks up nearby enemies, with a per-target displacement lockout.

purpose: Recognize burrowed detection and the emergence threat.
title: Burrow / Unburrow

citations.quote: Rek'Sai cannot enter a tunnel while immobilized, grounded, or silenced.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Immobilization, grounding, and silence prevent tunnel entry.

citations.quote: Destroying a Tunnel while Rek'Sai is traversing it will not prevent her from reaching the opposite entrance.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Destroying a tunnel does not interrupt traversal already underway.

citations.quote: Rek'Sai bites the target enemy, dealing physical damage. At maximum Fury, Furious Bite's damage is increased and converted into true damage.

core_mechanics.summary: The bite becomes stronger true damage at maximum Fury.

citations.quote: Rek'Sai dashes in the target direction and creates a Tunnel in her wake that lasts for a while. Rek'Sai can travel through the Tunnel in either direction, which becomes disabled afterwards for a few seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: Tunnel provides a dash and a reusable passage with a traversal lockout.

citations.quote: Enemy champions can destroy a Tunnel by standing on either entrance

core_mechanics.summary: Enemy champions can destroy tunnels at either entrance.

purpose: Recognize the Fury-dependent bite and removable movement routes.
title: Furious Bite / Tunnel

citations.quote: Once she has started to dash through the target however, she will no longer track them.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Tracking ends when she begins dashing through the target.

citations.quote: Rek'Sai marks enemy champions she damages with Marked as Prey

core_mechanics.summary: Damaging enemy champions marks them as eligible targets.

citations.quote: She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target

core_mechanics.summary: Void Rush briefly makes her untargetable before lunging at a marked target.

purpose: Recognize marked-target pursuit and its resistance to interruption.
title: Void Rush
